name: post.job_refused
description: The scheduler's word that a job's send was refused: no person's yes, or the platform refused it. The job fails with the reason, so the calendar shows it and a person can retry. A job that no longer waits is left alone.
sql: update brandbase.post_jobs j set status = 'failed', error = case :code::text when 'NEEDS_APPROVAL' then 'Waiting for a person to approve this send.' else coalesce(:message::text, 'The send failed.') end, updated_at = now() where j.id = :input::jsonb ->> 'job' and j.brand_id = :input::jsonb ->> 'brand' and j.status = 'scheduled' and coalesce(:code::text, '') <> 'NOT_FOUND' returning j.id, j.status, j.error
